verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ontology support (RDF/OWL files that map entity types/classes and individuals to canonical concepts) and custom Task extension via DataPoints for domain-specific logic, both directly enabling schema/ontology customization. However, evidence lacks detail on defining custom edge types or a full schema-definition API/workflow, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of this customization in practice. Missing for 10: concrete edge-type customization docs, a worked example of defining a custom ontology/schema end-to-end, independent verification of the feature working as described.
